title: Military Discontent Uprisings Ramosi Uprising
definition: The Ramosi Uprising was a series of agrarian-military revolts in the Western Ghats (Maharashtra) during the 19th century, triggered by the displacement of the Ramosis from their traditional role as hill police and the subsequent economic distress caused by British land revenue policies.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests the transition of traditional martial classes into rebels due to colonial administrative restructuring. It highlights the intersection of tribal identity, economic dispossession, and anti-colonial resistance.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Military Discontent Uprisings Ramosi Uprising.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Colonial Administrative Restructuring in Western India
